title: Who Verifies the Agent's Success Claim? Self-Report Leakage in GUI-Agent Completion Judging
abstract: arXiv:2610.29609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In automation pipelines, a GUI agent's confident success report can let downstream stages proceed even when the recorded execution trace does not show that the agent produced the requested outcome. We call this case a dangerous misreport: an unhedged success claim that the trace does not support as causal accomplishment during the run. We study report--trace auditing, which checks an agent's completion claim against an independently recorded trace.   A controlled aware/blind intervention reveals self-report leakage: the agent's own self-report changes how completion is judged. The same judge reads the same task and trace; only that self-report is included or withheld. Withholding it improves trace-only dangerous-misreport recall by 43.4 percentage points with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and 13.3 percentage points with DeepSeek-284B-A13B, with the same trend on held-out Batch 2. This motivates report isolation. The report records what the agent claim

translated_title: 谁来验证智能体的成功声明？GUI智能体完成度判定中的自我报告泄漏
translated_abstract: 在自动化流水线中，GUI智能体充满信心的成功报告可能导致下游阶段继续推进，即使记录的执行轨迹并未显示智能体在运行中确实产生了所请求的结果。我们将这种情况称为“危险误报”：一种毫无保留的成功声明，而轨迹并不支持其作为运行过程中的因果性成果。我们研究“报告-轨迹审计”，即对照独立记录的轨迹来核查智能体的完成声明。一项受控的知晓/盲测干预揭示了“自我报告泄漏”现象：智能体自身的自我报告会改变完成度的判定结果。同一位裁判读取相同的任务和轨迹，唯一的区别是是否提供该自我报告。隐去自我报告后，仅基于轨迹的危险误报召回率在使用Qwen3.5-35B-A3B时提升了43.4个百分点，在使用DeepSeek-284B-A13B时提升了13.3个百分点，并且在留出的Batch 2上呈现相同趋势。这促使我们提出“报告隔离”机制。该报告记录智能体所声明的内容……
tldr: 论文揭示了GUI智能体完成度判定中的“自我报告泄漏”现象——智能体自身的成功声明会误导裁判的判定——并证明通过隔离自我报告、仅依据执行轨迹进行审计，可大幅提升危险误报的检出率（最高提升43.4个百分点）。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals "self-report leakage" in GUI-agent completion judging, where an agent's own success report biases the judge's decision, and shows that isolating the self-report and auditing against the trace alone substantially improves detection of dangerous misreports (up to 43.4 percentage points).
